data: What are the phases of the Three-Phase NE Recognition System?

The Three-Phase NE Recognition System consists of three phases:

1. Phase 1: Candidate Generator - This phase generates candidate entities from the input document.
2. Phase 2: Lexical Analyzer - This phase analyzes the lexical structure of the generated candidates.
3. Phase 3: Segmentation Checker - This phase checks the segmentation of the candidates and produces the final result.
